simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to קָמַט (H7059) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: קָמַט (qâmaṭ) means to pluck , i.e. destroy First listed occurrence: Job 16 8.

definitions.full: H7059. qamat [ קָמַט ] verb seize (Late Hebrew id., seize, grasp, press together ; Arabic bind together ; Aramaic קְמַט = Biblical Hebrew; seize, compress ); — Qal Imperfect 2masculine singular suffix וַתִּקְמְטֵנִי Job 16:8 and thou didst seize me . Pu`al be snatched (untimely) Perfect 3plural קֻמְּטוּ Job 22:16 .
